title: To amend the Public Health Service Act to reauthorize a military and civilian partnership for trauma readiness grant program.
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
summary: This bill reauthorizes through FY2029 the Military and Civilian Partnership for Trauma Readiness Grant Program. This program enables civilian trauma centers to incorporate military trauma care providers into trauma care and practice at such facilities.

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
